## Description
Briefly describe the tools, models, or research papers added or updated in this pull request.

## Checklist
- [ ] Added entry in alphabetical order within its category.
- [ ] Link is valid and resolves over HTTPS.
- [ ] Assigned to the appropriate category/skill tier.
- [ ] Tool is actively maintained with clear documentation.
- [ ] Factual, neutral description without promotional hype ("best", "SOTA", etc.) or unverified claims.
- [ ] Included source link and verified active status.
- [ ] Ran `python scripts/verify_catalog.py` locally to sync `docs/tools.json`.
- [ ] Disclosed AI assistance in accordance with repository contribution guidelines.
